collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SL Class 2001 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz SL Class Roadster 2001 to 2012 (230) will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
